title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 5 — Washington ESPN Roster Alias Repair
root_cause: Two Step-5 source-boundary defects blocked IND-WAS: canonical WAS was passed directly to the ESPN roster loader even though ESPN TEAM_IDS uses WSH; after that alias was repaired, the healthy NFLverse 2026 dataset had no Week-4 rows yet because the future week had not been published, leaving both teams with zero nflverse target-week rows.
patch: Translate only WAS -> WSH at the ESPN lookup boundary, and when an exact NFLverse target week is unpublished for a current/future game, allow only the latest common prior week when it is exactly one week behind. Preserve exact ESPN athlete-ID, position, active-status agreement across ESPN + NFLverse and fail closed for older or asymmetric snapshots.
acceptance: WAS resolves through WSH only at the ESPN current-roster lookup boundary.
Exact target NFLverse week remains preferred whenever published.
Current/future games may use only the latest common prior NFLverse week when it is exactly one week behind.
Fallback fails closed when more than one week stale or not common to both teams.
IND-WAS verified roster truth is LIVE with ESPN + NFLVERSE and reports requested week 4 / used week 3.
Availability/depth truth is LIVE for the same verified handoff.
Unified roster is visible and a QB is selectable.
Open prop page reaches Visual V2 Steps 2-4 and Line Lab.
One public freeze proof passes after merge.
